name: 子弹风暴
description: 选择正方向，生成随自身移动的6格射击区域[3]。每回合结束时，破墙并对区域内所有敌人造成1倍伤害。与【左轮手枪】互斥。
code: function executeSkill(context){var c=context.piece,p=selectTarget({type:'grid',range:6,filter:'all'});if(!p||p.needsTargetSelection)return p;var dx=Math.sign(p.x-c.x),dy=Math.sign(p.y-c.y);if((dx===0&&dy===0)||(dx!==0&&dy!==0))return{success:false,message:'请选择施法者以外的方向格'};if(!battle.extensions)battle.extensions={};if(!battle.extensions.coltZones)battle.extensions.coltZones={};battle.extensions.coltZones[c.instanceId]={sourceId:c.instanceId,kind:'storm',dx:dx,dy:dy,turns:3};var zoneId='colt-zone-'+c.instanceId;removeStatusEffectById(c.instanceId,zoneId);addStatusEffectById(c.instanceId,{id:zoneId,type:'colt-zone',name:'子弹风暴区域',description:'随施法者位置移动；与左轮手枪互斥。',currentDuration:-1,currentUses:-1,stacks:3,intensity:3});return{success:true,message:c.name+'布置子弹风暴区域（随自身移动，持续3回合）'};}
